thread:
Alex (AE): Heads-up — Kestrel (POC) asking for 35% off hosted + dedicated GPUs for a 6mo pilot. They want a short contract, low commit. Can we make that happen?
Maria (AM): Are they asking discount on hosted usage only or on the dedicated reserved capacity too?
Alex (AE): Both. Hosted gen + embeddings and a small dedicated pool for latency-sensitive calls. Proposal came from customer: 35% off list, no upfront commit.
Samir (Deal Desk): 35% w/o any commit is tough. We can consider ~25% for a 6mo POC if they provide a minimal usage floor or a refundable deposit.
Dana (Finance): Need to know expected ARR equivalent and margin impact. Our price floor for dedicated is usually no deeper than 22% unless exec sign-off.
Jules (CS): Also flag: they require an on-prem private deployment option for certain endpoints if the PII portion grows — that will add infra/setup costs we should recoup.
Alex (AE): They want a simple yes/no today. Can we ship a counter-offer: 25% off with a 6mo usage minimum (we define), or 35% as a credit against first-year committed spend?
Samir (Deal Desk): That second option (35% as a one-time credit applied to future committed annual spend) is workable. Keeps list price intact and preserves our commit economics.
Maria (AM): If we do credit, what's the typical structure? Example: $X credit applied if they convert to 12mo commit within 90d of POC end.
Dana (Finance): Yes — tie the credit to conversion. Also need the legal term: credit expires if no conversion. No retroactive refunds.
pricing-bot: Rate card v3 link: https://intranet/ratecard/v3 — baseline hosted gen = list, dedicated pool = reserved pricing table.
Samir (Deal Desk): Action: Alex, post expected monthly token/embedding volumes + whether dedicated pool is required for full POC or just 30% of traffic. I can draft a counter-offer: Option A = 25% off for 6mo with 50% usage floor; Option B = 35% one-time credit of up to $XXk applied to 12mo commit if signed within 90d.
Alex (AE): I’ll get them to confirm volumes by EOD. Also they asked about a security questionnaire — Jules, will that change the timeline/costs?
Jules (CS): If they want SOC2 scoping or on-prem integration, expect a 2–4 week additional lead time and potential professional services cost. Recommend quoting PS separately.
Samir (Deal Desk): Cool. If PS is needed, exclude that from discount — discounts only apply to platform fees.
Maria (AM): One more: any precedent approvals for >30% off in a pilot?
Dana (Finance): Last year we approved a 40% effective concession but it was structured as a multi-year committed rebate tied to strict SLAs and carveouts. Requires VP sign-off.
Alex (AE): Ok — I’ll collect volume numbers and security ask. Samir — can you draft the two options and a short summary for VP approval if they push >30%?
Samir (Deal Desk): Yep. Will draft and attach a cost/margin analysis. Please add customer legal entity and point of contact in the thread so I can prepare terms for deal desk review.
Alex (AE): POC contact = rachel@kestrel.ai. Sending volumes shortly. Thanks all :thumbsup:
